cards.title: Safe Script Header
cards.description: Exit on errors, unset variables, and failed pipelines.

cards.title: Variables and Arguments
cards.description: Quote expansions unless you explicitly need splitting.

cards.title: Conditionals
cards.code:
if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "Found $file"
elif [[ -d "$file" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Directory'
fi

cards.title: Loop Safely
cards.code:
while IFS= read -r line; do
  printf '%s\n' "$line"
done < input.txt

cards.title: Find and Transform
cards.code:
find src -type f -name '*.ts' -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  printf '%s\n' "$file"
done
cards.description: Null delimiters preserve spaces in filenames.

cards.title: Dangerous Expansion
cards.code:
# Dangerous: rm -rf $target/*
# Validate and quote exact targets before destructive actions.
cards.description: Empty variables and globs can broaden destructive commands.

cards.title: Debugging
cards.code:
bash -n script.sh
shellcheck script.sh
bash -x script.sh
cards.description: Syntax-check, lint, then trace when needed.
